summary: The response stated that air quality near Hamlin-Garland School would not be significantly impacted by the Airport Spur, that noise abatement measures would be implemented in cooperation with the School Board, and that school access would not be interrupted since the freeway would be on embankment with local streets bridged over it.
text: Our studies indicate that the air quality in the vicinity of Hamlin-Garland School will not be significantly impacted with construction of the Airport Spur. Corrective abatement measures to reduce noise levels will be done in cooperation with the School Board. Since the freeway will be in embankment and local through streets will be bridged, access to the school will not be interrupted.
